title: Playboy Magazine November 2006 - Complete with Centerfold, Good
descriptionText: The product is a complete issue of Playboy Magazine from November 2006, featuring a centerfold. This vintage magazine is in English and includes illustrations related to women, art, and photography. It is part of the monthly publication frequency and was originated in the United States. The magazine is a collectible item that captures the essence of the popular culture and lifestyle during that time period, making it a must-have for fans of Playboy or vintage magazines.
